title: lpaths
description: `lpaths` demonstrates the distinction between `self._canvaspath`, the directory of the canvas where the object was created, and `self._loadpath`, the directory from which its `.pd_lua` file was loaded. The `postpath` and `load` messages use `_canvaspath`, while `postpathx` and `loadx` use `_loadpath`; both paths include a trailing slash for convenience.
